# Connect marker lines in sparse ARC grids

## Pattern
A demonstrated task has a sparse field of color-2 points. Two points share a row and serve as the endpoints of the main horizontal segment; other points lie above or below that row. The output preserves the color-2 markers and paints color 3 in the empty cells of the main segment and in vertical branches from each other marker to that segment.

## Procedure
1. Preserve the input dimensions and all original color-2 cells.
2. Find the pair of color-2 markers aligned on the same row that bracket the central horizontal run. Paint every intervening cell on that row color 3.
3. For each remaining color-2 marker, paint the cells in its column between it and the main row color 3, stopping before the marker and main segment. Leave unrelated cells at 0.
4. Check grid shape carefully: exactly the same number of rows and columns as the input, each cell an integer 0–9.
